description: Composite EBSD figure of the necking region after tensile fracture, mixing three panel types. (a) "Kikuchi pattern quality and phase distribution map": three greyscale EBSD maps for AN750-T, AN800-T and AN850-T (25 µm scale bars). Each map carries a phase legend giving the red Austenite fraction: 0.018 (AN750-T), 0.004 (AN800-T) and 0.002 (AN850-T). Yellow dashed boxes mark the areas magnified in (b) and yellow arrows mark the characteristic lines analysed in (c). (b) "Kikuchi pattern quality and KAM": three colour maps with a 0–5 colour bar (Min 0, Max 5) and 2 µm scale bars; dark-blue matrix is labelled "F", green/red elongated features are labelled "Hard region", and red ellipses plus white pixels mark stress-concentration/micropore sites. (c) "Point-to-point orientation difference and Kikuchi pattern quality distribution statistics": three dual-axis line plots, x = Distance (µm) ticked 0–5, left axis Point-to-point misorientation (°) 0–60 (black curve), right red axis Image quality map value (10⁴) 0–8 (red curve); grey shaded bands are labelled "Hard region" and pale gaps "F". Printed P-T-P_AVE values are 3.50, 4.48 and 3.50. The figure argues that misorientation spikes coincide with the grey hard-region bands exactly where the image-quality curve falls to minima, locating strain concentration and dislocation accumulation at phase interfaces.

subfigures.description: Three greyscale Kikuchi-pattern-quality/phase-distribution EBSD maps labelled AN750-T, AN800-T and AN850-T, each with a 25 µm scale bar. Phase tables give red Austenite fractions of 0.018, 0.004 and 0.002 respectively. Yellow dashed boxes (magnified in (b)) and yellow arrows (lines traced in (c)) are overlaid.

Three Kikuchi-pattern-quality + KAM colour maps with a Min 0 / Max 5 colour bar and 2 µm scale bars. Dark-blue matrix regions are labelled 'F'; green-to-red elongated bands are labelled 'Hard region'; red ellipses circle stress-concentration features and white pixels mark micropore-prone sites.

Three side-by-side dual-axis line plots: black point-to-point misorientation (°, left axis 0–60) and red image-quality map value (10⁴, right axis 0–8) versus Distance (µm) 0–5. Grey bands labelled 'Hard region' and pale gaps labelled 'F'; printed P-T-P_AVE values 3.50, 4.48 and 3.50.

observations.observation: Panel (a) shows three Kikuchi pattern quality / phase distribution maps labelled AN750-T, AN800-T and AN850-T, each with a 25 µm scale bar.
The phase legend in (a) gives red-mapped Austenite fractions of 0.018 for AN750-T, 0.004 for AN800-T and 0.002 for AN850-T.
Panel (c) plots two quantities on dual axes: Point-to-point misorientation (°) 0–60 on the left and Image quality map value (10⁴) 0–8 on the right red axis, versus Distance (µm) on the x-axis.
Grey shaded bands in (c) are annotated 'Hard region' and the intervening pale regions are annotated 'F'.
Printed average point-to-point misorientation values in (c) are P-T-P_AVE: 3.50, P-T-P_AVE: 4.48 and P-T-P_AVE: 3.50.
In (c), sharp black misorientation spikes coincide with the grey 'Hard region' bands, where the red image-quality curve simultaneously drops toward its minima.
Panel (b) maps are shown on a Min 0 / Max 5 colour scale with 2 µm scale bars, with dark-blue 'F' domains surrounding green/red 'Hard region' bands.
The caption states panel (c) reports 'Point-to-point orientation difference and Kikuchi pattern quality distribution statistics'.
The caption states the whole figure is 'EBSD analysis of necking position after tensile fracture'.
The citation states EBSD was performed on the necking region and that, compared with the pre-deformation state, the RA (retained austenite) content of AN750-T, AN800-T and AN850-T decreased.
The citation states the yellow dashed box areas in Fig. 12(a) were selected for magnified characterization.

The citation states stress concentration mainly occurs in the hard regions represented by B/TM and FM (highlighted in red), and that the white pixel areas are regions prone to micropore nucleation and expansion during deformation (Fig. 12(b)).

The citation states that when the characteristic line crosses a phase boundary the orientation difference increases sharply and the Kikuchi pattern quality drops to a minimum, indicating significant strain and intense dislocation accumulation at the phase interface.
The citation defines P-T-P_AVE as the average of the P-T-P orientation difference.
